title: 'What the hell is that?', The Ukrainian military drone footage captured a completely silent, disc-shaped UFO hovering over the front line
excerpt: The Ukrainian military filmed an “absolutely silent disc-shaped UFO” hovering over the front line. He was spotted using a Mavic drone
content:
Ukrainian servicemen videotape a disk-shaped UFO

The Ukrainian military recorded the flight of a disk-shaped UFO hovering over the front line.

This is reported by the Daily Mail and publishes the video.

The UFO was spotted by soldiers of the 406th Brigade using a Mavic drone. Their drone was more than 150 meters (492 feet) above sea level.

“What can they shoot at us with? Fucking hell,” ‘What the hell is that?’, ‘UFOs or something like that,’ Ukrainian military officers discuss on video whether to attack the object.

It is reported that the unknown object could be the size of a large ship and is more than 50 kilometers away.

The thermal imager showed that the UFO was warmer than its surroundings, but the technology produced a red error message that prevented the military from learning more about the object.

https://ua-stena.info/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/нло.mp4

It is noted that this flying object bore a striking resemblance to a thin cylindrical object seen over Iraq.

In May 2022, the infrared thermal camera of the U.S. Air Force Reaper drone recorded a mysterious object. It’s been dubbed the Baghdad Ghost.

https://ua-stena.info/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/BAGHDAD-PHANTOM.mp4

Experts believe this could also be a case of the mirage phenomenon known as Fata Morgana.

This mirage occurs when a top layer of warm air and a bottom layer of cold air create an “atmospheric channel” that refracts or bends light, creating reflections in the air.
